tasks.subject: Task 1: Multi-file InkWorld + sources-aware compile path
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `InkWorld` serves additional named Typst sources so an assembled document can `#import` them; a new compile entry point threads sources in without changing `compile_to_document`'s signature.

**Files:**
- Modify: crates/inkapp-core/src/world.rs
- Modify: crates/inkapp-core/src/render.rs
- Test: crates/inkapp-core/tests/multifile_world.rs (create)

**Verify:** cargo test -p inkapp-core --test multifile_world

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-core/src/world.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/render.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/tests/multifile_world.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test -p inkapp-core --test multifile_world", "acceptanceCriteria": ["with_sources registers resolvable sources", "compile_to_document_with_sources compiles imports", "compile_to_document unchanged", "missing import fails"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: #region prelude + Component::typst_sources hook + driver assembly
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Provide the `#region(name, body)` Typst prelude, a `Component::typst_sources()` default-empty hook, and a render driver that collects sources, prepends `#import`s, and compiles via the sources-aware path.

**Files:**
- Create: crates/inkapp-core/typst/region.typ
- Modify: crates/inkapp-core/src/component.rs
- Modify: crates/inkapp-core/src/runtime.rs
- Modify: crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs, crates/inkapp/src/lib.rs
- Test: crates/inkapp-core/tests/region_prelude.rs (create)

**Verify:** cargo test -p inkapp-core --test region_prelude

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-core/typst/region.typ", "crates/inkapp-core/src/component.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/runtime.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs", "crates/inkapp/src/lib.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/tests/region_prelude.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test -p inkapp-core --test region_prelude", "acceptanceCriteria": ["region.typ defines region(name,body)", "typst_sources default empty", "document_source prepends imports deduped", "compile_document compiles sources-aware", "region rect matches inline within 0.01pt"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Convert Checkbox render half to authored Typst
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Move Checkbox presentation into baked checkbox.typ, make `Component::render` emit `#checkbox(name, label)` wrapped via `#region` (affordance only, 14x14), declare it via `typst_sources`, and prove render->recover->decode round-trips through the driver.

**Files:**
- Create: crates/inkapp-core/typst/checkbox.typ
- Modify: crates/inkapp-core/src/components/checkbox.rs
- Modify: crates/inkapp-core/tests/checkbox_component.rs

**Verify:** cargo test -p inkapp-core --test checkbox_component

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-core/typst/checkbox.typ", "crates/inkapp-core/src/components/checkbox.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/tests/checkbox_component.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test -p inkapp-core --test checkbox_component", "acceptanceCriteria": ["checkbox.typ defines checkbox(name,label) via #region", "Component::render emits #checkbox call only", "typst_sources returns checkbox.typ", "region recovers 14x14 and decode round-trips", "Widget render_at untouched"]}
```
